items.title: Investors cut tech exposure by the most since 2006: BofA survey
items.summary:
Bank of America's (BAC) Fund Managers Survey shows that net tech overweight fell from 37% to 12% — the largest monthly reduction in 20 years.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the details.

items.title: Bank of America (BAC) Study Finds 84% Of Small Firms Now Use AI
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) reports in its 2026 Business Owner Report that 84% of surveyed firms now use AI in some form. The study finds small and mid-sized businesses continue to fund technology and AI projects despite higher operating costs. Respondents indicate expectations that these AI and tech investments will support revenue growth and better customer experiences.
